disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to register or reregister an apiary as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who fails or refuses to register or reregister as provided in this part is subject to a civil penalty as set forth in 80-6-303

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the conditions of a quarantine or selling quarantined bees or equipment without a permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person may not sell or offer for sale any apiary site, bees, or equipment under quarantine unless a permit authorizing the sale or removal is issued by the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a rule, order, or provision of a quarantine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person failing to comply with a rule, order, or provision of a quarantine pursuant to this section is subject to penalties provided for in 80-6-303.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transporting bees or beekeeping equipment into Montana without required certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who transports bees or beekeeping equipment into Montana shall present the required certification to the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transporting bees in packages or queen cages without a certificate of health from the originating state or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person or common carrier may not transport or bring bees into this state in packages or queen cages unless the packages or queen cages are accompanied by a certificate of health issued by the official inspector of the state or country from which they came.

definition_quote.value: "Apiary" means a location where one or more colonies of bees are kept or one or more hives containing honeycombs or bee combs are kept.
definition_quote.quote: "Apiary" means a location where one or more colonies of bees are kept or one or more hives containing honeycombs or bee combs are kept.

registration_required.quote: A person who owns or possesses an apiary in the state shall, before April 1 each year, reregister the apiary site.

apiary_identification_required.quote: Suitable evidence of registration must be posted by the apiary registrant in a conspicuous place at or near the apiary site.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: the location of the apiary site, specifically the nearest quarter section, section, township, and range or the GPS coordinates of the site

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: If an apiary site is not regularly attended in accordance with good beekeeping practice and that lack of attendance comprises a hazard or threat to disease or pest control in the beekeeping industry... the apiary site may be considered abandoned and the bees and equipment at the site may be seized by the department.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: Bees and beekeeping equipment, unless under a certificate of health that allows for seasonal transportation of bees and beekeeping equipment into Montana without inspection, that are transported into Montana from another state must be certified as pest-free and disease-free by either the originating state or by the department.

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: "Pest" means the African honeybee (Apis mellifera scutellata and Apis mellifera capensis), those honeybees Africanized by interbreeding with the African honeybee

regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee diseases" means a disease or abnormal condition of egg, larval, pupal, or adult stages of bees. Specific bee diseases that are subject to regulation under parts 1 through 3 of this chapter must be designated by department rule.

quarantine_authority.quote: quarantine any apiary site where pests, foulbrood, or any other contagious or infectious diseases are present

right_of_entry_scope.quote: enter private land containing an apiary site and fly over or enter any farm, railroad right-of-way, or other grounds or premises containing an apiary site to determine the health or ownership of the bees. The department shall provide at least 24 hours' notice to a private landowner before entering private land.

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: A person may not sell or offer for sale any apiary site, bees, or equipment under quarantine unless a permit authorizing the sale or removal is issued by the department.

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: general apiary sites must be located 3 or more miles apart except as otherwise provided in this part.

inspection_fee_charged.quote: inspect any apiary site at the request of and at the expense of any interested party
